subject: Portal onboarding: identity proofing, MSA redlines, and PO routing
messages:
From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@procureworks.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@procureworks.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal onboarding items: identity proofing + redlined MSA + PO routing questions

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — ProcureWorks is keen to move forward with Redwood for our supplier portal integration. Before we start provisioning vendor accounts in Ariba, legal and procurement asked me to confirm a few items so we can avoid back-and-forth during the portal activation: 

1) MSA redlines: attaching the redline we received (MSA_Redline_v2.docx). A couple of commercial points are straightforward, but our in-house counsel flagged the indemnity paragraph + data residency clause. Can you confirm Redwood's standard position and whether a limited-scope amendment is acceptable for enterprise customers?

2) Identity proofing / evidence bundle: our onboarding checklist requires a supplier evidence bundle (W9 or W8, DUNS or Legal Entity ID, signed seller form). Please confirm which documents Redwood needs from vendors vs. what you can accept as portal attributes. I've attached ProcureWorks-Seller-Form.pdf for reference.

3) PO routing & order form fields: procurement needs to ensure PO fields map cleanly for three things: tax jurisdiction, cost center code, and remit-to address. I've attached OrderForm_Spec.xlsx with our current PO schema. Is there a preferred PO field naming pattern you recommend for Ariba/Coupa mappings?

We'd like to get the legal redline clarified this week so we can schedule a configuration window next Tuesday for onboarding. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call with your legal ops if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Susan
ProcureWorks | Supplier Enablement
procurement@procureworks.com

Attachments: ProcureWorks-Seller-Form.pdf (pdf, 210KB), MSA_Redline_v2.docx (docx, 38KB), OrderForm_Spec.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@procureworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding items: identity proofing + redlined MSA + PO routing questions

Hi Susan — thanks for the detailed note and the attachments, this is perfect. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- MSA redlines: Noted the indemnity and data residency asks. I'll run the redline by our legal ops and get back with a principled response (likely a limited addendum for data residency and a narrow carve for indemnity). If possible please mark any clauses you consider \"deal breakers\" in the doc so our counsel can prioritize.

- Evidence bundle: Redwood requires a legal entity attestation (W9/W8 or equivalent), plus a signed seller form for payment routing. We can accept DUNS or a government-issued registration number. We can also store the remit-to as structured portal attributes so vendor onboarding doesn't require extra paperwork in many cases.

- PO mapping: The OrderForm_Spec looks standard. We recommend the following field names for vendor config: tax_jurisdiction (string), remit_address_id (uuid), cost_center (string). We'll provide an Ariba/Coupa field mapping template before the configuration window.

Next steps: I'll loop in our legal ops and product ops to propose a short call. How does Tue 10 Jun 11:00 AM PT look for you? If that's no good, propose two alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Cc'ing Marissa to start the redline coordination.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
